limits: Reported accuracy is a provisional ASR reference word-duration proxy. Elapsed audible ad remainder and show loss remain unknown.
Words and their zero-duration points do not classify interword gaps, uncovered audio, music, silence or missing speech.
No complete listened sponsor-read inventory is supplied; unknown whole-read coverage cannot become a verified pass.
Protected parody controls preserve existing reference roles and word IDs; they do not independently verify payment or the actual performance.
All source references were consumed for development, and no independent human listening is claimed.
Failed F remains in the comparison with missing scores and no complete speed result; its short partial attempt is not a faster successful variant.
Same-source/reference cohorts are compared separately; recordings and annotation formats are not pooled into a single ranking.
Only five planned full attempts were permitted, with no repeat-until-pass selection. Single runs cannot establish timing distributions.
The strict application default remains unchanged. Exploratory tolerance columns do not approve cuts or select a new product target.

post_timing_output_audits.interpretation: Source-word consistency checks cuts against saved model labels, not independent reference accuracy. It does not replace the commercial reference word-duration remainder.
post_timing_output_audits.retained_gap_scope: Only retained gaps between commercial-labeled words are counted; this is not a complete episode-wide inventory of unknown audio.
post_timing_output_audits.decoded_timeline_limit: Outputs match the declared edit timeline. Full decoded originals extend approximately 26.12 ms beyond declared duration; the audible significance is not established.
